description: Dedicated read-only current-identity decisions surface; no vector-search group/egress or write-route semantics.

conditions: build includes agent support (not noagent and not nomcp)
mount.absentBehavior: 404 with no observer/subscription work; no new listener, backend, repository access or network egress. Independent of active run, LLM backend and agent.agui.

authorization.identity: full Principal.BindingKey including OIDC subject, across that identity's sessions
authorization.description: Existing bearer AuthVerifier only, including gateway-forwarded console ID token where auth.oidc.enabled and explicit auth.oidc.routes decisions permit it. No cookie or URL-token parsing. Explicit authenticated identity required even on anonymous-loopback listeners; never fall back to LocalPrincipal. No new tool group/egress grant or approval authority.

retention.liveRecords: Existing broker/thread authorities retain their own quotas; avoid duplicate unbounded live storage. New UAR live observation projection is capped at 64 globally, one current open approval per existing owned thread. Eviction is observational, never consent, denial or permission to execute.
retention.historyStartedAt: process-local observer initialization; no durable replay or repository persistence

pagination.cursorPrivacy: HMAC-authenticate using process secret and bind ownership with a process-keyed opaque identity tag; never base64-encode a raw BindingKey/subject/principal. Existing unsigned pagination.go cursors are insufficient.
pagination.stale: 409 cursor_refresh_required with current caller epoch/revision; signature/foreign owner/malformed cursor is generic400 invalid_argument

subscription.authDeadline: close no later than AuthVerifier verdict expiration; do not extend using middleware clock-skew grace
subscription.revocation: close on known invalidation/config principal removal, credential expiry, feature disable, context cancellation or disconnect; re-authenticate every reconnect
subscription.slowConsumer: atomically replace queued hints with one snapshot_required at latest own revision; if write misses deadline, disconnect and release subscriber
subscription.sseId: omit SSE id and promise no replay; Last-Event-ID is not a replay cursor
subscription.lastEventId: ignore for replay and send fresh initial snapshot_required
subscription.reconnect: subscribe before reading current own revision; client buffers invalidations while authenticated paginated snapshot loads, retries stale pages, reconciles epoch and refetches on overflow; never claims freshness after silently dropped events

routes.description: Reserved literal events route takes precedence over item ID routing.

statuses.400: invalid_argument: malformed query/ID/cursor/body, unknown/repeated query, any URL credential; no raw query echoed
statuses.401: missing/invalid/expired credential or JWT route not opted in; shared auth challenge
statuses.404: feature unmounted or unknown/foreign/evicted item; no existence oracle
statuses.405: anything but GET/OPTIONS, Allow: GET, OPTIONS; no HEAD/mutation
statuses.409: cursor_refresh_required: authenticated own epoch/revision/expiry changed; read a fresh first page
statuses.429: subscriber cap, Retry-After: 5, no new stream allocation
statuses.500: safe internal route failure; no sensitive detail

continuation: Only DecisionObservation.actions current capability hints. Existing authenticated POST /agui resume for exact owned open interruption; native-required approve stays false. No /decisions write/resolve endpoint. Other records name authorized host/native destination; UAR synthetic approval stays backend_approval.
